name: MapCallout
label: Map callout
description: The annotation beside a map point: a name in capitals over monospace readout lines.

props.name: title
props.description:
The place's name, set in capitals: "Santiago, CL". Intentionally shadows
the native `title` tooltip attribute, which MapCallout does not expose.

props.name: lines
props.description: Readout lines under the title, in order: a status, a reading, a route.

props.name: align
props.description:
Which way the text ranges. A callout sitting left of its marker ranges
right so it hangs off the point; `start` is the ordinary reading order.
